newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIA'S HOWARD SEES END TO GROWTH SPEED LIMITS.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIA'S HOWARD SEES END TO GROWTH SPEED LIMITS.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard on Wednesday said comments on economic growth by Reserve Bank governor Ian Macfarlane showed the central bank saw no need for speed limits on growth.

"I can't remember in the 23 years that I've been in parliament a Reserve Bank governor effectively saying that, at the very least in the short term, the speed limits are off economic growth in Australia," Howard told reporters.

"In the past, Reserve Bank governors have been in the business of saying you can't take the speed limits off because you'll have a currency crisis, you'll have a balance of payments crisis, or you'll have a problem with inflation or a problem with wages," Howard said.

Macfarlane said in a speech on Tuesday night that the bank did not have a growth ceiling and that the economy could grow 4.5 percent or more over the next few years without sparking a blowout in inflation.
Howard said Macfarlane's comments were an endorsement of the Liberal-National government's economic policies.
